description: This file declares the TpmKeymasterEnforcement class, which implements keymaster::KeymasterEnforcement interface, providing TPM-based enforcement functionalities for Android's keymaster system. It includes method declarations for validation, cryptographic operations, and token management, and references external TPM management components.

classes.name: TpmKeymasterEnforcement
classes.description: A class implementing keymaster::KeymasterEnforcement that utilizes TPM resources for key management enforcement, including validation, cryptographic operations, and token handling.
